description: Look up one scholarly work by DOI (10.xxxx/..., doi.org URL), arXiv id (arXiv:1706.03762) or OpenAlex work id (W...). Returns title, authors, year, venue, DOI, citation count, references count, open-access PDF link, abstract, OpenAlex id and a retraction flag (OpenAlex is_retracted plus Crossref/Retraction Watch notices). Data: OpenAlex (CC0, openalex.org) with Crossref REST (crossref.org) for retraction notices and as fallback. Not-found and upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC per lookup via x402.

id.description: DOI, doi.org URL, arXiv:id or OpenAlex work id
